_help: Songs for the 'Get up!' dance party. Each break plays one song (a different one each time, in random order) for about 60 seconds; kids can Pause or skip to the Next one. 'id' is the YouTube video ID, 'start' is seconds into the video. Use videos that allow embedding (official 'Audio' or '- Topic' versions start the music right away). These videos are always allowed.
